name: Shinkyoku Soukai Polyphonica ~Farewell Song~
original_name: 神曲奏界ポリフォニカ ～Farewell Song～
source:
A cave-in at a certain ruins resulted in the complete loss of the excavation party affiliated with Maynard University. It happened when they took out ‘something’ from the sarcophagus deep inside. Afterwards, two young girls who were actually founder spirits, Richelie and Esther, visited Phoron and Corticarte and warned them that the spirit-eating ‘harvester’ has awakened.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/05/25/may-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
某處遺蹟發生坍方，隸屬美那朵大學的考古隊全員失蹤。事故發生前，他們從遺蹟深處的石棺中取出了「某樣東西」。之後，真實身分是始祖精靈的兩名少女莉修莉與艾絲特找到塔塔拉．佛隆和克緹卡兒蒂，警告他們吞噬精靈的「收割者」已經甦醒。

[譯自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/05/25/may-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
